pre_recall_public_pairs.cpsc_title: Mohnark Pharmaceuticals Recalls Lidocaine Topical Anesthetic Cream Due to Failure to Meet Child-Resistant Packaging Requirement; Risk of Poisoning (Recall Alert)
pre_recall_public_pairs.incident_description:
Monhark 4% Lidocaine Cream does not have the required child safety cap.  The cap is just a regular flip that is very easy to open.  I bought it on Amazon.  Here is the link:

https://www.amazon.com/Lidocaine-4-Topical-Anesthetic-Cream/dp/B08FTL2RMH
pre_recall_public_pairs.product_description: 4% Lidocaine Cream in a tube with a flip top cap.  Expiration date:  9/2023

pre_recall_public_pairs.cpsc_product_name: BLACK+DECKER Model HGS011 Easy Garment Steamers
pre_recall_public_pairs.cpsc_title: Empower Brands Recalls Black+Decker® Garment Steamers Due to Burn Hazard
pre_recall_public_pairs.incident_description:
I purchased a Black & Decker HGS011F Clothing Steamer. I followed all safety precautions, and only filled the water tank to half of the "Max Fill" line. As soon as the water heated up, instead of just steam, boiling water came spewing out of the steamer head, nearly burning my hand. I have a video demonstrating this happening. I have reported it to B & D customer support but feel this requires a report to the CSPC as well.

When I tried uploading a video and photos to this report, the CSPC web site returned an error. I have the video available.
pre_recall_public_pairs.product_description: Black and Decker HGS011F Easy Garment Steamer
